task: Archetype library picker (owner ask 2026-07-16: character library filtered by style selections). Stream 2 of the recording-cue expansion, worktree recording-cue-persona-samples-be5e50.

frontend/src/pages/Voices/components/met.summary: Rewritten from a flat SearchableSelect combobox into a ranked character-library dropdown. New optional `attrs?: Partial<VoiceAttributes>` prop: when the caller's current selections have any value, the 39 archetypes are ranked by the shared scoreArchetype() (recordingPromptSuggester.ts) descending, sectioned into 'Best matches' (score >= CLOSE_THRESHOLD, badged 'Close match'/'Match' via CLOSE/EXACT thresholds) and 'All characters' — narrowing never hides entries. No attrs -> alphabetical searchable list (previous behavior). New exports: rankArchetypes(), matchTier(), hasMeaningfulAttrs(), RankedArchetype, ArchetypeMatchTier. onPick contract unchanged (still overwrites all 6 fields). No longer imports SearchableSelect (inlined an equivalent dropdown with richer rows).

frontend/src/pages/VoiceLab/components/r.summary: Passes its `value` (the 6 matcher fields) as ArchetypeQuickPick's attrs so the library re-narrows live as fields change.

frontend/src/pages/VoiceLab/components/O.summary: Passes the voice's current `attrs` state to ArchetypeQuickPick so the library narrows by the voice's existing metadata.

frontend/tests/unit/voices/archetypeQuic.summary: Unit tests for ranking/narrowing: attrs -> order (agrees with scoreArchetype, ties alphabetical), thresholds -> tiers, empty attrs -> full alphabetical list, ranked UI sections/badges, search narrowing, onPick 6-field payload.

flow_impact: Archetype quick-pick flow in both OverviewTab (metadata) and Record mode now ranks/sections by current selections instead of a flat alphabetical combobox; pick semantics unchanged.
